To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a comprehensive comparative study and analysis of state-of-the- art real-time object detection framework, and based on the analysis results, we propose a design space exploration method to maximize the energy- efficiency (mAP/wh) of real-time image detection solution.
we can achieve better energy efficiency in real-time object detection in mobile heterogeneous SoC by adjusting the design parameters and exploring the design space of CNN-based detection framework.

we propose a framework to optimize the performance of CNN-based object recognition in heterogeneous embedded SoC, and we successfully demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework by achieving the state-of-art result in the LPIRC challenge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to design and implement a cost-effective object detection solution for embedded heterogeneous SoCs.
the design space exploration and implementation of real-time object detector in mobile heterogeneous SoC.
the design, implementation and evaluation of real-time object recognition and detection solutions in heterogeneous SoCs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed CNN-based object detection solution can be applied to real-time object detection in mobile GPUs with a high energy-efficiency.

the proposed design space exploration method can effectively maximize the mAP/Wh of CNN-based real-time object detection solutions in embedded heterogeneous SoCs, while the design parameters of detection frameworks can be adjusted to trade-off between prediction accuracy (mAP) and energy consumption (Wh).

the proposed design space exploration procedure and the corresponding implementation of real-time object detectors can be a good starting point for designing CNN-based object detection solutions in mobile SoCs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a systematic study and analysis on state-of-the-art deep CNN-based object detection solutions in mobile GPU devices.
the design space exploration and optimization procedure can be a useful tool to improve the energy-efficiency for CNN-based real-time object detection solutions in mobile GPUs.
we propose a design space exploration framework to maximize energy efficiency of CNN-based object recognition in heterogeneous SoC and we demonstrate its effectiveness with a real-world case study.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the energy-efficiency in mobile GPU devices can be significantly improved by adjusting design parameters of object detection solutions.

we can significantly improve the cost-effectiveness and energy-efficiency of real-time object recognition solution in off-the-shelve mobile GPU devices by adjusting the design parameters of state-of-the-arts CNN-based detection frameworks.

we provide an insight on how to design a CNN-based object detection framework to maximize the energy efficiency of real-time image recognition in mobile SoCs, and we provide a design space exploration tool for the community to optimize the energy-efficiency in mobile SoCs.
